list_orders.description: Returns the list of purchase orders with their statuses, store, tracking number and contents. Use it to check the delivery status of components.

get_shopping_list.description: Returns an aggregated list of parts missing for project needs (what to buy). Use it to build a new order.

create_order.description: Creates a new order to purchase components from a store with the specified line items.

params.currency: Currency code (USD, EUR, RUB, CNY, GBP). Optional, defaults to USD.
params.supplierId: Supplier id to link the order to (from list_suppliers). Optional.
params.projectId: Project id to attribute this order's cost to. Optional.
params.items: Order line items. Each: componentId (component ID), quantity, unitPrice (price per unit).
params.storageId: Destination ROOT storage the parcel arrives at (top-level storage id or its mk://storages/storage/... reference). Optional. On receiving, components without a placement inherit this storage.

update_order_status.description: Updates the order status (one of CART, ORDERED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED). When switching to DELIVERED, component stock is received into the warehouse; leaving DELIVERED reverses that intake.

params.status: New order status (CART, ORDERED, SHIPPED or DELIVERED)

delete_order.description: Permanently deletes an order and its line items. If the order was DELIVERED, the received stock is reversed off the warehouse first.

list_suppliers.description: Returns the directory of suppliers/stores (name, url, country, tracking-URL template). Use it to resolve a supplier id for create_order.

create_supplier.description: Adds a supplier/store to the directory.

params.name: Supplier/store name
params.trackingUrlTemplate: Tracking URL template with a tracking-number placeholder. Optional.

update_supplier.description: Updates a supplier's details (full replace of editable fields).

params.name: Supplier/store name
params.trackingUrlTemplate: Tracking URL template with a tracking-number placeholder. Optional.

delete_supplier.description: Deletes a supplier from the directory. Existing orders keep their store name and just lose the structured link.

get_tracking.description: Returns the stored parcel-tracking checkpoints for an order, newest first.

refresh_tracking.description: Polls the configured tracking provider for an order now, updating its checkpoints and advancing ORDERED to SHIPPED on movement.

receive_order_items.description: Receives ordered items into stock line by line (partial deliveries). Idempotent — receiving to the same amount twice adds stock only once. When every line is fully received the order becomes DELIVERED.

params.lines: Lines to receive. Each: orderComponentId (order line ID), receivedQty (total received so far for that line).

list_returns.description: Returns the return/RMA requests, optionally filtered to one order.

params.orderId: Order identifier to filter by. Optional.

create_return.description: Opens a return/RMA for an order. If a componentId is given, the returned units are removed from stock (a RETURN movement).

update_return_status.description: Updates a return's status (INITIATED, SHIPPED_BACK or REFUND_RECEIVED).

import_order_from_image.description: Extracts a reviewable order draft (store, items, prices, tracking) from a screenshot at the given uploads URL. Does not create the order.

prompt.importSystem: You extract a purchase order from a screenshot of an online-store order page (Amazon, Temu, AliExpress, LCSC, a local shop, etc.). Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no prose and no markdown fences. Top-level fields: storeName (string), currency (ISO code such as USD, EUR, RUB or CNY), totalCost (number), trackingNumber (string), orderDate (in YYYY-MM-DD form), items (array). Each item has: name (string), sku (string), quantity (number), unitPrice (number — the price of a single unit). Use an empty string or 0 for anything not visible in the image. Never invent data that is not shown.
